description: Defines the WindowManager class for HTTP/2 flow control, managing window sizes and notifications.

classes.name: WindowManager
classes.description: Manages HTTP/2 flow control window, notifies listener when window updates are needed.

methods.name: WindowManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing window manager with size limit, listener, and optional update function.

methods.name: CurrentWindowSize
methods.description: Returns current flow control window size.

methods.name: OnWindowSizeLimitChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the window size limit.

methods.name: SetWindowSizeLimit
methods.description: Sets a new window size limit and notifies listener if needed.

methods.name: MarkDataBuffered
methods.description: Increments buffered data bytes; returns true if more window remains.

methods.name: MarkDataFlushed
methods.description: Increments flushed data bytes and may notify listener.

methods.name: MarkWindowConsumed
methods.description: Convenience method to mark data as buffered and flushed.

methods.name: IncreaseWindow
methods.description: Increases window size without affecting limit.

methods.name: MaybeNotifyListener
methods.description: Checks conditions and notifies listener if window update is needed.
